globalRules: Strict dark-mode default palette (Obsidian Black background, Champagne Gold accents, Warm Slate surfaces)
All interactive elements and touch targets must measure at least 48x48dp for premium touch ergonomics
Optimistic UI updates applied to all preference selections and time slot picks for latency-free interaction
Multi-tier tactile haptic engine: subtle light feedback for selection, medium crisp tick for slot highlight, heavy double pulse for booking confirmation
Offline caching enabled for Client Vault history, dynamic QR tickets, and saved style formula notes
Typography scale strictly enforced: Serif font family for titles/headings to convey luxury; Sans-Serif font for UI body labels and numerical values

colorSemantics: Champagne Gold (#D4AF37) - Luxury Brand Accent & Active States
Velvet Navy (#1A2238) - VIP Tier Cards & Highlight Surfaces
Ivory White (#F9F8F6) - Primary Text & High-Contrast Headings
Emerald Gold (#2E5A44) - Confirmation & Success State Badge
designRequirementsForStitch.typographyGuidelines: Luxury typographic hierarchy combining Classic Display Serif (e.g., Cinzel or Playfair Display) for titles, headings, and pricing figures with Clean Geometric Sans-Serif (e.g., SF Pro Display or Inter) for body text, form controls, and time slot indicators.
designRequirementsForStitch.spacingAndGrid: Rhythmic 8pt design grid system utilizing 8px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, and 64px structural tokens with generous negative space to evoke an ultra-premium, high-end feel.
componentVariantsNeeded: Golden CTA Button (Default, Hover/Focus, Pressed (0.96x), Disabled, Loading Spinner)
Time Slot Chip (Available, Selected-Gold, Reserved-Disabled, Recommended)
Concierge Toggle Switch (Active Gold, Inactive Charcoal, Disabled)
Stylist Profile Card (Compact Horizontal, Full Vertical Showcase, Minimal Vault Strip)
Input Field (Default Dark Glass, Focused Gold Border, Validated Checkmark, Error Alert Red)
motionAndMicroInteractions: Silky smooth modal slide-ups using a custom cubic-bezier timing curve (300ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1))
Subtle 3D ticket flip rotation (180deg flip, 350ms duration) for digital VIP QR receipts
Golden border pulse animation when tapping high-priority actions like Quick Rebook or Time Slot selection
Skeleton shimmer effect utilizing a luxury muted golden-slate wave pattern for loading states
